accepted_defects.invariant: Masked and non-finite samples are excluded from both the signal and normalization, and insufficient support is unavailable rather than a detection.
accepted_defects.root_cause: The first matched-filter comparison treated missing support as zero-valued signal, depressing normalized responses beside masks.

accepted_defects.invariant: A source at an image boundary retains its normalized response whenever the declared minimum support is present.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Zero padding reduced matched-filter response near a finite image edge and made the result depend on distance from the boundary.

accepted_defects.invariant: Irregular extended sources use an original-pixel signed-flux centroid and deterministic supported peak, with typed unavailability rather than compact-fit errors.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Compact fitted-centroid semantics were initially reused for irregular extended segments whose location is a detected-support measurement.

accepted_defects.invariant: A legitimate detected island remains in support and topology products when no Gaussian catalogue row can be published.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Early external-product translation dropped mask-only or moment-only detections when a Gaussian fit was unavailable.

accepted_defects.invariant: Continuum peak and integrated flux use signed original-image pixels and never the filtered detection response.
accepted_defects.root_cause: A development compiler mixed detection-domain reconstruction with observable-domain continuum photometry.

accepted_defects.invariant: Continuum flux is measured in the reviewed 1.5-major-beam nearest-owned aperture without double counting adjacent sources.
accepted_defects.root_cause: The historical four-beam aperture was unbiased but accumulated avoidable noise and a wrapper later silently restored that default.

accepted_defects.invariant: Residual-B3 boundary refinement updates mask, labels, support, catalogue inputs, and diagnostics as one consistent product composition.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Sub-beam cleanup and partially updated product fields caused near-threshold mask precision failures and internally inconsistent support.

accepted_defects.invariant: Extended positions use direct-plus-B3 weights, retain direct weights for compact-dominated segments, and fall back explicitly when denoised weights are unavailable.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Unrestricted B3 centroid weights improved diffuse sources but regressed compact-dominated, image-edge, and filled-diffuse position strata.

accepted_defects.invariant: A source record and its Gaussian component retain their distinct fitted-total, peak, and morphology semantics.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Rapthor source canonicalization had been applied to fitted Gaussian-component products, replacing unresolved fitted totals with peak flux.

accepted_defects.invariant: A valid independent free ellipse remains publishable on the Gaussian component even when the conservative source model is beam constrained.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Publishing the conservative beam-or-free source model as the component discarded an available fitted ellipse and regressed fitted-axis results.

accepted_defects.invariant: The reviewed fitted-total bias calibration applies only to the Gaussian-component total and rejects non-positive corrected values.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Compact fitted-total uncertainty and bias tails required a component-specific correction without altering source-level photometry.

accepted_defects.invariant: External compact compilation always requests fitted-Gaussian-component semantics and retains typed translation failures.
accepted_defects.root_cause: The failed post-correction compiler invoked the Phase 4 diagnostic with its Rapthor-source default instead of component semantics.

accepted_defects.invariant: One adapter binds configuration identity, residual-B3 support, reviewed aperture, regularized position weights, and product serialization and rejects any identity drift.
accepted_defects.root_cause: A one-look campaign executed the expected source revision but silently composed historical product defaults rather than the approved candidate configuration.

accepted_defects.invariant: Hebog and every reference finder are scored on the same declared valid-pixel domain while catalogue photometry remains separate from support topology.
accepted_defects.root_cause: The external compiler contract did not previously prove that invalid-pixel clipping was symmetric across all finders.

accepted_defects.invariant: Only the exact approved Hebog invocation receives the immutable repository source path; reference and materialization commands are unchanged.
accepted_defects.root_cause: The frozen recovery image could not import the approved prospective module because its command omitted the repository source path.

accepted_defects.invariant: A reconstructed reference-only replay uses the approved immutable candidate runtime record and rejects an unapproved candidate revision.
accepted_defects.root_cause: Reference reconstruction supplied no historical candidate run, leaving the prospective candidate runtime record incomplete and unhashable.

accepted_defects.invariant: Recovery evaluation preserves both the prospective compiler-seam identity and the base accelerator identity recorded in the immutable analysis.
accepted_defects.root_cause: The frozen evaluator passed the recovery compiler identity into inherited validation that required the base accelerator recorded by the analysis.
